facebook.content:
Today, let's focus on interceding for our nation. Our nation is facing a crisis of leadership and values. Let's pray for a shift in the hearts and minds of those in power.

"Lord, raise up leaders who will govern with integrity, justice, and righteousness. Give them wisdom and discernment to make decisions that honor you and benefit all citizens."

Join me in praying for this shift. Drop a ✝️ if you're standing in agreement. Share your own prayer request in the comments below.
